# Third-party Python vendored into build123d-lite

`src/worker/Build123dDrafting.js` is generated by `scripts/vendor-drafting.py` from three Apache-2.0 projects by Paul Fremantle and contributors. Their licences are in the directories here; none ships a NOTICE file.

| module (importable in Python mode) | from | commit |
|---|---|---|
| `build123d_drafting`: `find_holes`, `find_bosses`, `find_hole_patterns`, `feature_diameters`, the feature records; `recognise_countersinks` | [build123d-drafting-helpers](https://github.com/pzfreo/build123d-drafting-helpers) `src/build123d_drafting/features.py`, plus [build123d-mcp](https://github.com/pzfreo/build123d-mcp) `tools/recognizers/countersink.py` | 9217f82, 59b2561 |
| `augura`: `analyze()` and the BREP checks it runs (overhangs, manifold, tip-over, brim, minimum feature, thin walls, bed fit) | [augura](https://github.com/pzfreo/augura) `src/augura/{report,footprint,overhangs,manifold,tip_over,brim,min_feature,wall_thickness,bed_fit,analyze}.py`, flattened | f701006 |
| `_cs_mcp_features`: the MCP tools' serializers and the bored-boss candidate search | build123d-mcp `tools/find_features.py` | 59b2561 |

**Modifications.** They are mechanical, made by the script, and listed in each module's header comment:
- **OCP:** the imports go to the `_cs_ocp` shim (`src/worker/CsOcpShim.js`, new code).
- **Dataclasses and enums:** frozen dataclasses become `_cs_ocp.Record` subclasses with explicit field lists, and `StrEnum` members become `_cs_ocp.StrEnumValue`. MicroPython keeps no `__annotations__` and has no metaclasses for this.
- **MicroPython syntax gaps:** `zip(strict=)` is dropped; `(*a, b)` becomes `tuple(a) + (b,)`; `tuple[...]` type aliases become `tuple`; `numbers.Real` becomes `(int, float)`; `re` look-arounds are rewritten by hand.
- **Imports:** module-level imports move or are dropped where the shim registration order needs it.
- **augura:** the mesh (trimesh) and CadQuery paths are left out.

The tests are `examples/cloudflare-worker/scripts/mcp-test.mjs` (the `find_*` and `analyze_printability` checks) and `test/python-mode.spec.js`.
